applyDecision.menu: Add the 74 approved rows to the existing active menu without replacing its menu or item IDs. Record every inserted row and make rollback deactivate only those inserted rows; do not delete anything.

applyDecision.logo: Set the website-sourced logo only when the verified profile has no logo. Preserve any later nonblank logo.
applyDecision.address: Do not change the verified profile address from imported evidence and never project a static address as a live truck stop.
applyDecision.youtube: Do not change the verified profile YouTube value from conflicting imported evidence.
applyDecision.schedule: Do not publish expired or undated stops. An absent fresh stop must remain visibly unavailable.
applyDecision.account: Preserve the existing account, owner linkage, profile ID, claim and subscription state, analytics, reviews, and confirmed fields.
